title: A region-wide, multi-year set of crop field boundary labels for Africa
description: 825,395 official crop field boundary labels for Africa, sourced from the Agricultural Impacts Research Group's Lacuna Labels dataset. Covers a region-wide, multi-year collection across sub-Saharan Africa with crop category classifications. Distributed as a fiboa-compliant GeoParquet file converted from the original source.

## README.md
# Field boundaries for Lacuna Labels

Provides 825,395 official field boundaries from Lacuna Labels.
It has been converted to a fiboa GeoParquet file from data obtained from Agricultural Impacts Research Group.

- **Source Data Provider:** [Agricultural Impacts Research Group](https://github.com/agroimpacts/lacunalabels)
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **License:** Planet’s [participant license agreement for the NICFI contract](https://assets.planet.com/docs/Planet_ParticipantLicenseAgreement_NICFI.pdf).
- **Projection:** epsg:4326 (WGS 84)

---

- [Download the data as fiboa GeoParquet](https://source.coop/fiboa/lacunalabels/lacunalabels.parquet)
- [STAC Browser](https://radiantearth.github.io/stac-browser/#/external/data.source.coop/fiboa/lacunalabels/stac/collection.json)
- [STAC Collection](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/lacunalabels/stac/collection.json)
- [PMTiles](https://data.source.coop/fiboa/lacunalabels/lacunalabels.pmtiles)

## Columns

| Property | **Data Type** | Description                                                               |
|----------|---------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| id       | string        | Field Identifier                                                          |
| category | string        | Course category; annualcropland, cloudshadow, fallow, treecrop, unsure1/2 |

## Lineage

- Data downloaded on 2024-11-12 from https://zenodo.org/records/11060871 .
- Converted to GeoParquet using [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli), version 0.7.0
